body:
#2756 (TASK-1930) round 1: CHANGES REQUESTED at dc2ada6920. Full findings: .aida/review-verdicts/PR-2756.json in the primary checkout. Round 2 is FINAL (2-round cap). Fix all MAJOR and MINOR items:

1. LOCK ORDER (A1, binding). The store lock is taken BEFORE blocks.lock, everywhere: db_block.rs:247, requirements_cli.rs:3090, doctor_cmd.rs:13292 and 14010. Fix the comment at requirements_cli.rs:3085-3089, which states the inverted rule. Never blocks.lock -> store.
2. FAIL CLOSED. In acquire_claim (~800) and acquire_lock_claim (~1276), only a genuine "held by someone else" may map to Unavailable. Store-lock timeout, an unsafe store, a write/add failure and serialization errors must propagate as Err.
3. READ INSIDE THE LOCK. In doctor_repair_stale_blocks, doctor_migrate_counter_scope and doctor_verify_relationships, re-load (or verify unchanged) under the store lock before saving. Keep the interactive prompt outside the lock, then re-read and re-validate inside it.
4. INVENTORY (the TASK-1930 deliverable). Add docs/plans/2026-10-19-store-writer-inventory.md: every store writer path with a source reference, marked protected / newly wrapped / private-init / read-only, and listing the remaining doctor/compaction writers as named follow-ups.
5. TESTS that fail when the lock is removed. Use a handshake, not a sleep: the child signals "in lock" through a file or pipe, and the parent asserts it blocks. Cover at least coordination claim, schedule_ledger CAS, alias link_cas and db block claim.
6. In schedule_ledger write_cas_opts and write_batch_cas_opts, keep the original error, and drop the redundant ensure_store_write_safe.
7. In acquire_claim and acquire_lock_claim, a commit error is an error, never "committed" (no unwrap_or(true)). Never roll back a SHA you didn't create.
8. push_exact refuses an empty SHA. Remove the unwrap_or_default at db_block.rs ~955.

Merge origin/main if you're behind. Gate: check-ci-fast + targeted filters + check-ci-compile. Push, then mail the advisor with the SHA and one line per item.
subject: #2756 round-1 CHANGES REQUESTED (TASK-1930), final round next
